description: A floor-length dark forest-green fitted noble gown with low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves, ornate gold knotwork woven borders around the neckline, bodice, cuffs, central front panel and hem. A fine cream linen layer shows in the narrow lower front opening. A broad decorated woven belt with round metal clasp shapes the waist. Round brooches fasten the shoulders and a green-and-brown checked wool wrap with fringed ends lies loosely around the arms. Dark brown leather shoes are visible beneath the skirt. No headgear, armor or weapons.
